input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

This scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 如果这把花对你的身体好：这把花对你的身体好不好，After 不知道, an embedded yes/no question needs the A-not-A form instead of 如果 plus a statement. [rule: a_not_a_question]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看如果这把花毒不毒：看这把花有没有毒，The part after 这就要看 must be a question form; 有没有毒 is the appropriate A-not-A question, without 如果. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：他吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，When choosing between two possibilities after 不知道, use 是……还是…… rather than 吃不吃……或者…… . [rule: a_not_a_question]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：自己的身体，The flower is being tested by 神农, so the body should refer back to the subject rather than to an unintroduced listener. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 花：其中的一朵花，The earlier phrase 别的花 introduces multiple flowers; this wording clearly identifies that he ate one flower from that group. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 很快：就很快，The pattern 一……就…… needs 就 to connect the first action with its immediate result. [teacher rule: yi_jiu]

items.reason: After 不知道, the embedded yes/no question should use 好不好 rather than 如果 plus a statement.
看如果这把花毒不毒 is incorrect here; 看这把花有没有毒 correctly supplies the question form without 如果.
The intended meaning is whether Shennong should eat it, so it needs 要不要吃; the proposed correction instead asks which plant he ate.
你的 introduces an unaddressed listener, while 神农 is testing the flower on his own body.
花 can be used generically in 他一吃花 and is not necessarily an unclear reference requiring 其中的一朵花.
The original already has 就 in 很快就生病了, satisfying 一……就……; adding another 就 would produce 就很快就生病了.
